teacher: orthogonal candidate sufficient statistics; block-constant continuous-Brownian skeleton
calibration: Gaussian H0 exact-arithmetic normalized likelihood mixtures; union over 2 bits, 16 methods, 8 durations, 1440/day or 720/12h attempts; half budget to scores
limitations: No triad pulse shape, carrier overlap, delay, Doppler, selective modulation, timing/epoch/CFO search or unknown noise.
Brownian phase is constant inside teacher blocks; convergence in this script does not validate continuous within-block waveform behavior.
C/N0 sweeps share paired phase and indexed noise. Counts refer to synthetic independent paths, not physical propagation reliability.
Known amplitude and orthogonal candidate patterns make this a favorable diagnostic. Oracle phase is unavailable to an ordinary receiver.
Time scaling preserves c*tau, T/tau, dt/tau only for this stipulated sufficient-statistic teacher, not an accelerated real channel.

diagnostics.grid_convergence_scope: automatic phase-grid changes also change frequency spacing; vary explicit frequency_grid_hz independently when separating the two discretization errors
diagnostics.transition_order: half old-frequency phase advection; frequency CTMC; half new-frequency phase advection; independent phase CTMC
diagnostics.memory_scope: owned state/temporary/cache array estimate; excludes framework runtime and allocator cache
diagnostics.model_scope: normalized finite-state likelihood with static proper gain quadrature and block-constant common phase; continuous colored oscillator and arbitrary within-block phase evolution are not exact models
diagnostics.null_scope: known white circular Gaussian null and fixed pre-observation priors; finite-precision validation/calibration is separate from the exact-arithmetic mean-one LR identity
